title: 减少对海量训练数据和人工编程的依赖 AI智能体让机器人快速掌握新技能
content: 【减少对海量训练数据和人工编程的依赖 AI智能体让机器人快速掌握新技能】机器人掌握一项新技能，往往需要工程师反复编写程序，或依靠大量数据训练。如今，人工智能（AI）智能体有望改变这一过程。据美国加州大学伯克利分校官网9日消息，该校研究团队提出一种名为“智能体机器人技术”的新方法，让多个AI智能体协同编写机器人控制程序，并在虚拟环境中反复测试、修正和优化。这一方法为具身智能领域的机器人自主控制和技能开发提供了新思路。

title: Medicus Pharma shares rationale as CD228V becomes lead development priority
content: Medicus Pharma CEO Dr Raza Bokhari joined Steve Darling from Proactive to discuss the company's third-quarter 2026 financial results, which showed a narrower net loss and lower general and administrative expenses as Medicus shifts its development focus towards CD228V, an antibody-drug conjugate licensed from Pfizer. For the three months ended September 30, 2026, Medicus reported a net loss of $15.2 million, or $11.64 per share, compared with a loss of $16 million, or $56.18 per share, in the same period last year. Medicus ended the quarter with $13.1 million in cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash, including $5 million in unrestricted cash and cash equivalents. Bokhari said the third quarter marked a transformation for Medicus into a precision oncology-focused biotechnology company, with CD228V now its principal development priority. Medicus holds an exclusive worldwide licence to develop, manufacture and commercialize CD228V through a co-development agreement with Pfizer, which has provided $2 million in development funding. The company is targeting initial clinical proof-of-concept in patients with relapsed, refractory or immunotherapy-resistant melanoma. The program is supported by an existing US investigational new drug application and a first-in-human Phase 1 study. Medicus believes CD228V could potentially achieve an objective response rate above 30% in melanoma, although that target has yet to be demonstrated in clinical trials. Pfizer also has the option to fund all or part of development costs beginning with the first pivotal trial. Medicus is also advancing plans to separate its SkinJect business through a proposed business combination with a special purpose acquisition company. Meanwhile, for Teverelix, the company has submitted a proposed seamless Phase 2b/3 clinical trial protocol to the US Food and Drug Administration for advanced prostate cancer. The study is designed to enrol approximately 608 patients, subject to meeting predefined criteria to proceed. title: Anthropic进军人工智能办公软件 IPO前与微软谷歌竞争升温

content: 【10年期美债发行认购需求不及预期 尽管票面利率创20年以来最高】美国财政部发行的420亿美元10年期国债中标收益率5.020%，高于纽约时间下午1点投标截止时5.010%的发行前交易收益率，显示需求不及预期。截至投标截止时，该期限美债收益率当日已上涨逾12个基点。发行结果公布后，收益率小幅走高，但仍处于当日波动区间内；2年期与10年期美债收益率之差则从当日最低水平略有回升，较周一收盘仍收窄约6个基点。尽管当前收益率水平仍低于上月发债时的中标收益率，但上月为增发，而本月新发行的10年期国债的票面利率为5%，将创2006年以来最高。一级交易商获配比例为9.8%，较上月的历史低点回升；间接投标人获配比例降至61.2%，抵消了直接投标人获配比例升至29%的影响，后者为2013年以来最高。投标倍数为2.46，过去六次10年期新债发行的平均投标倍数为2.45倍。
